bottleneck.description: Sole supplier of Roll-Out Solar Array (ROSA/iROSA) deployable solar wings powering the ISS, Lunar Gateway PPE, and Axiom Station, with 300+ patents and 100% on-orbit success across 1,000+ missions.

dependency.key_customers: NASA, Axiom Space, Boeing, Maxar, Thales Alenia Space, US Space Force, ESA
dependency.key_suppliers: Solar cell vendors (Spectrolab, Azur Space), composite & substrate manufacturers, MOOG (collaborator on ELSA contract)

editorial.notes: Redwire's ROSA/ELSA deployable solar arrays and in-space manufacturing IP (acquired via Deployable Space Systems) create real switching costs - qualification for crewed/long-duration platforms takes years and competitors Beyond Gravity and Airbus Defence & Space have different form factors. However, multiple deployable solar alternatives exist and RDW is one of several space-infrastructure component suppliers rather than a single chokepoint. MEDIUM reflects the qualification moat without overstating monopoly position.
